newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa, AGF dispose of stakes in reinsurer Scor.
newsitem.headline: Axa, AGF dispose of stakes in reinsurer Scor.

text.p: French insurers Axa and AGF said on Friday they had completed the disposal of their stakes in leading French reinsurance company Scor.
Both companies had flagged their intention of unloading their stakes in Scor, saying they were no longer core assets.
But the fact the shares were sold into the market and not sold to trade buyers dampened speculation that Scor could become a takeover target.
French insurer UAP also said it would dispose of a large portion of its 41 percent stake in Scor when it is listed on the New York Stock Exchange this autumn as long as market conditions were right.

Axa said it made a net capital gain of 22.5 million francs ($4.44 million) from the sale of its 9.7 percent holding. AGF made a net capital gain of 47 million from the sale of nine percent out of a total 9.71 percent stake.
Industry sources said one buyer of the shares had been a German investment fund. Predica, a unit of French mutual bank Credit Agricole, also bought two percent.

Interest in the shares has been fuelled by their recent outperformance of other French insurance stocks and was supported by speculative buying following a flurry of takeover activity in the international reinsurance sector.
But analysts played down the possibility Scor could become a bid target itself and said buying was driven by investors looking for value.
"I don't see anyone committing to anything. I think it's reasonable to assume Axa and AGF would have offered their stakes to a trade buyer before going to the market with them," one analyst said.

UAP chairman Jacques Friedmann said in June the insurer did not consider its Scor holding to be a strategic asset and that it could cut it at the time of Scor's New York listing, expected in late September.
Shares in Scor have climbed by more than 33 percent since the start of the year, making conditions ripe for disposal. They closed up two francs at 206 on Friday.
The French government founded Scor in 1970 to give France a reinsurer of international standing. ($1=5.063 French Franc)
